name: TravelAI - IBM Granite Travel Planner
description: An AI-powered travel planning assistant built on IBM Granite (watsonx.ai) with real-time live data integration. Generates complete trip plans including flights, hotels, day-by-day itinerary, budget breakdown, live weather, currency exchange rates and country facts.

IBM_WATSONX_API_KEY.description: Your IBM watsonx.ai API Key. Get it from IBM Cloud -> IAM -> API Keys.

IBM_WATSONX_PROJECT_ID.description: Your IBM watsonx.ai Project ID. Get it from watsonx.ai project -> Manage tab.

GRANITE_CHAT_MODEL.description: IBM Granite model ID to use for AI generation.

FLASK_ENV.description: Flask environment - use production for deployment.

SECRET_KEY.description: Flask secret key for session security. Use a long random string.

OPENWEATHER_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenWeatherMap API key. If blank, wttr.in is used for free weather data.

AMADEUS_API_KEY.description: Optional Amadeus Travel API key for live flight and hotel data.

AMADEUS_SANDBOX.description: Use Amadeus sandbox (test) environment. Set to False for production.

OPENTRIPMAP_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenTripMap API key for live tourist attractions data.
